questions.question: Shechem loved Dinah, Jacob's daughter, and spoke to her tenderly. What did he then tell his father Hamor?

answers.text: Get me this girl as a wife
Send her back to her father

questions.question: If Shechem and his father Hamor refused to be circumcised, what did Jacob's sons say they would do?
While the men of Shechem's city were still in pain from circumcision, which two sons of Jacob attacked with swords?
Jacob told Simeon and Levi they had brought trouble on him. How did they answer their father?

answers.text: They asked if Shechem should have treated their sister like a prostitute
They said they were sorry for the trouble they caused
They promised to make peace with the people of the land
